column1: # The shared names that have a /same-name/<slug>/ page: the commonest unresolved shared-name links of the built site.
# Written by `python3 tools/run-autolink.py --pick-same [--top N]` (N=10); the links column is the count then. The name is the ascii form;
# the accent forms and every other spelling of the name go to the same page. Edit by hand only to drop a name.
